# Original signature functions
```{r}
### MAMS
MAMS_6_amend <- function(counts) {
        genes = c("AIM2", "FCGR1BP", "CD274", "GBP1", "SMARCD3", "FLVCR2")
    return(colMedians(counts[genes, ]))
}

MAMS_6_mean <- function(counts) {
        genes = c("AIM2", "FCGR1BP", "CD274", "GBP1", "SMARCD3", "FLVCR2")
    return(colMeans(counts[genes, ]))
}


## Long-10
Long_10_mean <- function(counts) {
        genes = c("CD274", "KIF1B", "IL15", "TLR1", "TLR5", "FCGR1A", "GBP1",
                  "NOD2", "GBP2", "EGF")
    return(colMeans(counts[genes, ]))
}

## geometric mean
gm_mean = function(x, na.rm=TRUE){
  exp(sum(log(x[x > 0]), na.rm=na.rm) / length(x))
}

## Also amended
calc_RiskGeo_6<-function(counts){
        gene_set1=c('GBP2','FCGR1BP','SERPING1')
        gene_set2=c('TUBGCP6','TRMT2A','SDR39U1')
      return(gm_mean(counts[gene_set1],TRUE) - 
               gm_mean(counts[gene_set2],TRUE))
}

### Get Sweeney by hand
sweeney3 = function(counts){
   c((log2(counts['GBP5',]) + log2(counts['DUSP3',])) / 2 ) - log2(counts['KLF2',])
}
```

#### New formatting code - will check concordance after new analysis performed
```{r}
df<-counts_filtered[[1]]
df$gene_id<-sub("\\..*", "", df$gene_id)

gene_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                                   keys = df$gene_id,
                                   keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                                   column = "SYMBOL",
                                  multiVals = "first")

gene_map_df <-tibble(ENSEMBL = names(gene_map), SYMBOL = unname(gene_map))

counts_sym<-df |>
  as.data.frame()|>
  left_join(gene_map_df, by = c("gene_id" = "ENSEMBL")) |>
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "") |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(mean_expr = mean(c_across(where(is.numeric)))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(SYMBOL) |>
  slice_max(mean_expr, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) |> ## take the gene row with the highest expression 
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-c(mean_expr,gene_id)) |>
  column_to_rownames("SYMBOL")|>
  distinct(symbol, across(where(is.numeric)), .keep_all = TRUE)

counts_filtered[[1]]<-counts_sym
```



### Week 0 count mtx formatting
```{r}
## Format individual count files; put back into list
df<-counts_filtered[[1]]

# to get list of gene names for correction
#df_temp<-tibble::column_to_rownames(df,var='symbol')

## Correct gene names
df<-df %>%
  mutate(symbol = case_when(
    gene_id == "ENSG00000228696.12" ~ "ARL17B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000169627.9" ~ "BOLA2B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000283378.1" ~ "CNTNAP3C",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000237541.4" ~ "HLA-DQA2",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000260075.1" ~ "NSFP1",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000183889.13" ~ "NPIPA6",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000170667.16" ~ "RASA4B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000205572.11" ~ "SERF1B",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000205571.15" ~ "SMN2",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000274512.6" ~ "TBC1D3L",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000269226.8" ~ "TMSB15C",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000278970.5" ~ "HEIH",
    gene_id == "ENSG00000278662.6" ~ "GOLGA6L10",
    .default = symbol
  ))

# Novel transcripts - drop because probably not included in published signatures?
novel_transcripts<-c('ENSG00000226266.9','ENSG00000289720.1','ENSG00000285508.2',
                    'ENSG00000258790.1','ENSG00000289750.1','ENSG00000289755.2',
                    'ENSG00000285723.2')
df<- df[!(df$gene_id %in% novel_transcripts),]


# Same gene, different transcript name? Drop lowest expression?
duplicate_transcripts<-c('ENSG00000080947.16','ENSG00000287542.1','ENSG00000286112.1',
                    'ENSG00000280987.4','ENSG00000223705.12', 'ENSG00000285253.1',
                    'ENSG00000274615.1')
df <- df[!(df$gene_id %in% duplicate_transcripts),]


# drop rows with duplicate gex values + gene names (have different transcript)
counts_r <- unique( df[ , 2:17 ] )

# set rownames as symbol and drop gene_ids/old symbol
df_temp<-tibble::column_to_rownames(counts_r,var='symbol')
colnames(df_temp)

### Reassign
counts_filtered[[1]]<-df_temp
```

```{r}
# KYAT1 == both same gene ### drop ENSG00000286112.1 -  other ID listed in NIH as actual gene/listed as 'readthrough gene' in ensembl

# NPEPPSP1 == same gene ### drop ENSG00000274615.1; not listed in NIH as main ID; also not in TB signatures list
# ZNF280D == seem to be for different genes; drop ENSG00000285253.1 (other ensID listed on GeneCards)
duplicate_transcripts<-c('ENSG00000080947.16','ENSG00000287542.1','ENSG00000286112.1',
                    'ENSG00000280987.4','ENSG00000223705.12', 'ENSG00000285253.1',

df_temp<-tibble::column_to_rownames(counts_r,var='symbol')

counts_filtered[[2]]<-df_temp
```

## Metadata
```{r}
metadata<- read_csv('/Users/mairi.mcclean/Desktop/MAMS/recur/processed/clinical_var/relapse_control/modified/250206mm_demographics_for_TBSignPr.csv')
dat<-tibble::column_to_rownames(metadata,var='scrno')
dat$`...1`<-NULL
dat$visit<-NULL

### for all dfs in counts_filtered
ignore_cols<-c("gene_id", "symbol")

metadata_list <- lapply(counts_filtered, function(df) {
  cols_to_keep <- setdiff(colnames(df), ignore_cols)
  matched_rows <- dat[match(cols_to_keep, rownames(dat)), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(matched_rows) <- cols_to_keep
  matched_rows
})
```

# Set up SummarizedExperiment objects
## W0
```{r}
## set objects
se_0<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts = as.matrix(counts_filtered[[1]])),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[1]]))

data_in<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_0,'counts')
res<-deseq2_norm_rle(data_in)

## make a new object
w0_norm<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts=res),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[1]]))

### Get normalised + log-transformed (for Long-10)
w0_norm<- mkAssay(w0_norm, log = TRUE, counts_to_CPM=FALSE)

# Get VST trans
## DESeq with normalized counts
dds_0<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(res),
                               colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[1]]),
                               design = ~1)

## Now transform with rlog/VST and save count mtx
vsd<-vst(dds_0, blind=TRUE)
check<-vsd@assays@data@listData[[1]]
## add transformed mtx to SE object
w0_norm@assays@data@listData[["vst_counts"]]<-check
w0_norm
```

## W26
```{r}
# Get SummExp.
se_26<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts = as.matrix(counts_filtered[[5]])),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[5]]))

## Get DESeq norm.
data_in<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_26,'counts')
res<-deseq2_norm_rle(data_in)

## make a new object - with the normalisation from DESeq
w26_norm<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts=res),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[5]]))

### Get normalised + log-transformed (for Long-10)
w26_norm<- mkAssay(w26_norm, log = TRUE, counts_to_CPM=FALSE)


## Get VST transformation
dds_26<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(res),
                               colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[5]]),
                               design = ~1)

## Now transform with rlog/VST and save count mtx
vsd<-vst(dds_26, blind=TRUE)
check<-vsd@assays@data@listData[[1]]
## add all transformed mtx to SE object - 'counts' are still DESEQ-norm 
w26_norm@assays@data@listData[["vst_counts"]]<-check

w26_norm
```

### Week 14
```{r}
se_14<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts = as.matrix(counts_filtered[[3]])),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[3]]))

data_in<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_14,'counts')
res<-deseq2_norm_rle(data_in)

## make a new object
w14_norm<-SummarizedExperiment(list(counts=res),
                         colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[3]]))
### Get normalised + log-transformed (for Long-10)
w14_norm<- mkAssay(w14_norm, log = TRUE, counts_to_CPM=FALSE)


## DESeq with normalized counts
dds_14<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(res),
                               colData=DataFrame(metadata_list[[3]]),
                               design = ~1)
## Now transform with rlog/VST and save count mtx
vsd<-vst(dds_14, blind=TRUE)
check<-vsd@assays@data@listData[[1]]
## add transformed mtx to SE object
w14_norm@assays@data@listData[["vst_counts"]]<-check
```

### Add TPM counts to SE objects
```{r}
add_tpm_assay <- function(se, tpm_df) {
  # tpm_df: your cleaned data.frame/tibble, genes already as rownames
  tpm_mat <- as.matrix(tpm_df)
  
  missing_genes <- setdiff(rownames(se), rownames(tpm_mat))
  missing_samples <- setdiff(colnames(se), colnames(tpm_mat))
  
  if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
    message(length(missing_genes), " genes in SE not found in TPM data — will be NA")
  }
  if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
    stop("Samples missing from TPM data for this timepoint: ", 
         paste(missing_samples, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  aligned_tpm <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(se), ncol = ncol(se),
                         dimnames = list(rownames(se), colnames(se)))
  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(se), rownames(tpm_mat))
  aligned_tpm[common_genes, colnames(se)] <- tpm_mat[common_genes, colnames(se)]
  
  assay(se, "TPM") <- aligned_tpm
  se
}
```

```{r}
se_w0  <- add_tpm_assay(se_0,  TPMcount_files[[1]])
se_w1  <- add_tpm_assay(se_1,  TPMcount_files[[2]])
se_w2  <- add_tpm_assay(se_2,  TPMcount_files[[4]])
se_w9  <- add_tpm_assay(se_9,  TPMcount_files[[6]])
se_w14 <- add_tpm_assay(se_14, TPMcount_files[[3]])
se_w26 <- add_tpm_assay(se_26, TPMcount_files[[5]])
```

# Calculating new signature scores
```{r}
## to find location of gene in SE object: match(c("FLVCR2"),SummarizedExperiment@NAMES)
# ensure that Riskgeo_6 signature is added to TBsignaturesSplit object
TBsignaturesSplit$Riskgeo_6 <- list(
  Riskgeo_6_up=c('GBP2', 'FCGR1B', 'SERPING1'),
  Riskgeo_6_dn=c('TUBGCP6', 'TRMT2A', 'SDR39U1')
)

TBsignaturesSplit$MAMS6_amend <- list(
  MAMS6_up=c("AIM2", "FCGR1BP", "CD274"),
  MAMS6_dn=c("GBP1", "SMARCD3", "FLVCR2")
)
```

#### Week 0
```{r}
### Get counts mtx from SE object
### VST counts is like log2 transformation
w0_mtx<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(w0_norm,'counts') ## changed to 'counts' 10.12.25

#MAMS
MAMS_med<-MAMS_6_amend(w0_mtx)
names(MAMS_med)<-NULL
MAMS_means<-MAMS_6_mean(w0_mtx)
names(MAMS_means)<-NULL

#RISK6Geo
risk6_geo_scores<-apply(w0_mtx, 2, calc_RiskGeo_6)
names(risk6_geo_scores)<-NULL

## Sweeney - do on normalized counts? - 
## OG paper: "microarray data: background corrected using normal-exponential method, 
##            then quantile-normalized", then log transformed
## Warinske validation paper: normalized the data then calculated log in formula
Sweeney_sc<-sweeney3(w0_mtx)
names(Sweeney_sc)<-NULL

### Long-10
w0_Logmtx<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(w0_norm,'log_counts') # log of DESEQ_norm
Long10<-Long_10_mean(w0_Logmtx)
names(Long10)<-NULL


## Check that res cols and SE subjectIDs order match
w0_ogmodels@colData@rownames == colnames(w0_mtx)
# sig values stored:
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["MAMS_6_amended_OriginalModel"]]<-MAMS_med
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["MAMS_6_mean_OriginalModel"]]<-MAMS_means
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["RISKgeo_6_OriginalModel"]]<-risk6_geo_scores
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["Sweeney_Add_OriginalModel"]]<-Sweeney_sc

### log matrix
w0_ogmodels@colData@rownames == colnames(w0_Logmtx)
w0_ogmodels@colData@listData[["Long_10"]]<-Long10
```

## Calculate Tabone 27
### WK26
```{r}
##### log2 FC on VST normalized counts
## get W0 in df form
#w0_mtxVST<-SummarizedExperiment::assay(w0_norm,'vst_counts') 
w0_df<-as.data.frame(w0_mtx)
### subset by signatures
df<- w0_df[rownames(w0_df) %in% tb27,]

df<-t(df)
w0_tb27<-as.data.frame(df)
### Add time label to column end
colnames(w0_tb27) <-paste0(colnames(w0_tb27), "_0")

## WK26
## get W26 in df form
### 10.12.25: Use the normalised counts and then calculate the log2FC; not the
### VST_Transformed counts - this would complicate the FC calculation
w26_df<-as.data.frame(w26_mtx)
### subset by signatures
df<- w26_df[rownames(w26_df) %in% tb27,]
df<-t(df) 
w26_tb27<-as.data.frame(df)
### Add time label to column end
colnames(w26_tb27) <-paste0(colnames(w26_tb27), "_26")

# NOTE:# BA170X doesn't have both w0 and w26 timepoint - can't get FC
setdiff(rownames(w0_tb27), rownames(w26_tb27)) 

### Merge 
merged_df<-merge(w0_tb27, w26_tb27,by="row.names")

## Get FC by timepoint
fc_df<-data.frame(row.names=merged_df$Row.names)
test<-data.frame(row.names=merged_df$Row.names)

for (gene in tb27){
  col_t1<-paste0(gene, "_0")
  col_t2<-paste0(gene, "_26")
  if (col_t1 %in% colnames(merged_df)&& col_t2 %in% colnames(merged_df)){
    t1<-merged_df[[col_t1]]
    t2<-merged_df[[col_t2]]
    fc_df[[gene]]<-abs(log2((t2+1) / (t1 + 1))) ## changed 10.12.25
  }
}

#Should use differences in vst_counts, or ratio of only normalised counts

fc_df$tb27_score<- rowMeans(fc_df) ## Mean molecular distance from T0 in 27 study genes

#### Add to signature dfs
scores<-rep(NA,ncol(w26_ogmodels))
names(scores)<-colnames(w26_ogmodels)
length(scores)

matched<-intersect(rownames(fc_df), colnames(w26_ogmodels))
scores[matched]<-fc_df[matched, "tb27_score"]
## Add to object, including NAs
colData(w26_ogmodels)$Tabone27_OriginalModel<-scores
```

```{r}
rownames(df_formatted)<- rownames(df)
write.csv(df_formatted,"/data/_w14_signature_scores.csv")
```
